lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Seven distinct vertical white line segments traversing the dark torso; spacing is approximately 150-200 pixels between primary lines, with higher density in the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth lines from the anterior position are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso and failing to reach the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch, approximately midway between the spine and the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral, extending dorsolaterally from the pedicles before curving medially and terminating in a dorsal vertical orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.7 times the horizontal width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 18% of the total vertical horn length from base to apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white dorsal crest extending from neck to rump; white-to-yellowish gradient on lower limbs with a sharp dark horizontal band above the fetlocks; white chevron marking visible on the snout despite foreground occlusion.
